title: Semantically embedded end-to-end deep learning for battery energy storage system state-of-health estimation using field data
title_zh: 面向储能系统现场数据的语义嵌入端到端深度学习 SOH 估计
one_sentence: 将语义嵌入引入端到端深度学习框架，直接用储能电站现场数据估计电池系统 SOH。
problem: 储能现场数据存在工况多变、噪声大、标签稀缺、单体/模组异质性显著等问题，传统实验室标定式 SOH 模型难以直接迁移到实际 BESS 运行场景。
contributions: 提出语义嵌入（semantically embedded）的端到端深度学习 SOH 估计框架，将物理/工况语义信息显式注入网络表征
面向 BESS 现场数据设计，弱化对实验室标定标签的依赖，提升跨工况泛化
在真实储能系统数据上验证 SOH 估计能力，支撑系统级健康管理
bms_relevance: 直接命中 BMS 核心：SOH 估计 + 储能系统（BESS）+ 现场数据（field data），属于 pack/系统级健康评估与运维决策的输入环节。
insight_for_group: 可作为「field data 驱动 SOH」的方法基线：语义嵌入思路可迁移到 pack 不一致性建模，把单体离散度、温度/倍率工况作为语义条件注入，缓解现场标签稀缺与跨站迁移问题；也可与 physics-informed 分支对照，判断纯端到端与物理约束混合路线的边界。
reason: A 级。eTransportation 位于优先列表第 15 位，是可再生能源交通电气化与电池系统方向的专刊型高水平期刊；论文同时满足「BMS 核心问题（SOH）+ 真实规模化场景（BESS 现场数据）+ 方法创新（语义嵌入端到端）」三项，属于必读。注：RSS 未提供摘要，建议获取全文核实数据规模与验证方式。

title: Vehicle-level modeling of internal resistance degradation and influential parameter analysis in lithium-ion battery packs using real-world data

识别并量化影响内阻退化的关键参数（如温度、倍率、SOC 区间、使用强度等）

bms_relevance: 内阻是 BMS 中 SOH、功率能力（SOP）与不一致性评估的核心状态量；论文处于 pack/车辆系统级，使用 real-world/fleet 数据，与「pack-level state estimation + field data」完全对齐。
insight_for_group: 为课题组提供真实车队场景下的内阻退化建模范式：可把内阻退化参数敏感性结论用于 SOH/RUL 特征筛选，也可将其与我们的 pack 不一致性指标（单体间内阻离散度）联合建模；vehicle-level 的建模粒度对 cloud BMS 车队级健康运维尤其有参考价值。
reason: A 级。eTransportation（优先列表第 15 位）且为真实世界数据驱动的 pack 级退化建模，数据场景与问题定义都高度贴合课题组方向，方法具备直接复用性。注：RSS 未附摘要，建议核实数据来源（车队规模、车型、时长）。

title: Electrical short-circuit behavior and temporary localized overcharge conditions during thermal runaway in lithium-ion battery packs

problem: pack 内部热失控触发与传播过程中，电-热耦合的短路路径与局部电压异常（暂态过充）如何演化，缺少 pack 级实验证据。

title: Path-dependent degradation diagnosis of commercial NCA/graphite 18650 cells under coupled cycle-calendar aging via dual-tank model identification and differential voltage analysis
abstract: Accurate diagnosis of lithium-ion battery degradation under alternating cycling and storage is important for lifetime assessment and health management in practical energy-storage applications. However, degradation under coupled cycle-calendar aging is inherently path dependent, and the stage-wise evolution of physically interpretable aging indicators remains insufficiently resolved. In this work, a stage-resolved diagnostic framework covering the aging interval from the fresh condition toward an approximately 90% state-of-health (SOH) aged condition is developed for commercial NCR18650GA nickel cobalt aluminum oxide (NCA)/graphite cells by integrating multi-stage aging experiments, dual-tank model identification, and differential voltage analysis. A sequence-dependent protocol at 50 ° C is designed to compare continuous cycling with cycle–calendar–cycle paths under different storage state-of-charge (SOC) levels. Based on full-cell voltage-capacity data and half-cell open-circuit potential (OCP) curves, an electrochemically interpretable dual-tank model is established to identify electrode lithiation states, effective electrode capacities, and a lumped resistance-related term. The results suggest that the inserted calendar-aging stage alters the subsequent degradation trajectory rather than merely interrupting cycling. The cathode lithiation parameter y 0 decreases by 4.68%–5.36% from Stage 1 to Stage 3 in all groups, indicating a consistent shift in electrode balancing. Among the identified variables, the fitted resistance-related parameter R shows the clearest path dependence, with much stronger growth in Groups A and B than in Group C. For the fitted parameters R and C p , lowering the intermediate storage SOC from 75% to 25% progressively mitigates the final degradation response; the electrode-level differential-voltage metrics are path dependent and are not strictly monotonic with storage SOC. Differential-voltage analysis further suggests that uninterrupted cycling is associated with a stronger late-stage graphite anode signature, whereas intermediate-SOC storage is more consistent with electrode-balancing migration that becomes amplified after cycling resumes. Overall, the proposed framework provides a physically interpretable route for comparing degradation modes under hybrid aging histories and offers useful support for storage-strategy design and aging-aware battery management.
title_zh: 基于双罐模型辨识与差分电压分析的商用 NCA/石墨 18650 电池循环-日历耦合老化路径依赖退化诊断
one_sentence: 用双罐模型辨识结合差分电压分析，分阶段解析循环与日历耦合老化下的路径依赖退化机理。
problem: 实际储能场景中循环与静置交替进行，其耦合老化具有路径依赖性，但各阶段可物理解释的老化指标（电极嵌锂态、有效容量、阻抗项）演化尚不清晰。
contributions: 设计 50 °C 下序列相关协议，对比连续循环与「循环—日历—循环」不同存储 SOC 路径
建立电化学可解释双罐模型，辨识电极嵌锂参数、有效电极容量与集总电阻项
发现插入日历老化阶段会改变后续退化轨迹（非简单中断），并量化中间存储 SOC 由 75% 降至 25% 的缓解效应
bms_relevance: 面向 SOH 与寿命评估的可解释诊断方法，所用指标（嵌锂态、电极容量、内阻）可映射到 BMS 的 SOH/SOP 与不一致性评估，属于健康管理与寿命预测的直接支撑。
insight_for_group: 双罐模型 + DVA 的物理解释路线可迁移到 pack 不一致性归因：把单体嵌锂态偏移与有效容量差作为不一致性指纹，判断差异是「制造离散」还是「路径老化离散」；对 physics-informed 的 SOH 建模也是天然的可解释基线。
reason: B 级。Journal of Energy Storage 位于优先列表第 10 位，论文问题与 SOH/寿命管理强相关且物理可解释性强；但实验为 18650 单体层级、样本规模有限，未涉及 pack 级或现场车队验证，证据强度与期刊层级使其定为建议浏览。

title: Physics-informed unsupervised battery state-of-charge estimation via temperature-conditioned Mamba and parallel Bayesian inference
title_zh: 基于温度条件化 Mamba 与并行贝叶斯推断的物理信息无监督 SOC 估计
one_sentence: 用温度条件化 Mamba 生成物理状态空间模型参数，配合并行 IPLS 实现无标签、跨温度的 SOC 轨迹重建。
problem: SOC 估计依赖大量带标签数据，且在宽温域与不同驾驶工况下泛化差、参数量大、批处理效率低。
contributions: 提出 Mamba-IPLS 物理信息无监督框架：Mamba 骨干 + 温度条件化调制器（TCM）生成随环境温度变化的模型参数
以生成的参数驱动物理状态空间模型，用并行迭代后验线性化平滑器（IPLS）估计隐状态，总体计算复杂度 O(N)、并行跨度 O(log N)
在 −10 °C 至 50 °C 多种驾驶循环下，以更少可训练参数超越主流数据驱动基线，并通过消融验证 TCM 与 IPLS 的鲁棒性增益
bms_relevance: SOC 估计是 BMS 最核心的实时状态估计任务之一，温度条件化与无标签学习直接回应实车/储能场景的标签稀缺与宽温域难题。
insight_for_group: 两点可迁移：一是「温度条件化参数生成 + 物理状态空间」的结构，可复用于 pack 级 SOH/RUL 与温度耦合建模；二是无标签 + 贝叶斯平滑的路线，适合我们在 field data 上缺少真值标签的场景，可与不一致性估计联合设计。
reason: B 级。方法创新度（物理信息 + Mamba + 并行贝叶斯平滑）较强，但发表于 Journal of Energy Storage（优先列表第 10 位），验证以公开驾驶循环与单体/电池模型为主，缺少 pack 级与现场车队证据；源列表中存在同一论文的重复条目，已合并为一条。定为建议浏览、方法可借鉴。

title: Physics-informed unsupervised battery state-of-charge estimation via temperature-conditioned Mamba and parallel Bayesian inference
abstract: In this paper, we propose Mamba-IPLS, a physics-informed, unsupervised algorithm for offline, label-free battery state-of-charge (SOC) trajectory reconstruction. The architecture integrates a Mamba backbone with a Temperature-Conditioned Modulator (TCM) to generate model parameters under different ambient temperature conditions. For a sequence of length N , this Mamba–TCM neural parameter generator requires O ( N ) total work. The generated parameters drive a physical state–space model, where the latent battery states are estimated using a Parallel Iterated Posterior Linearization Smoother (IPLS). Each IPLS iteration also requires O ( N ) total work, while its associative filtering and smoothing scans have O ( log N ) parallel span. Comparative analysis within the unified Deep Neural Network (DNN)-IPLS architecture first reveals that the Mamba backbone exhibits superior batch-processing speed and stability compared to Transformer and long short term memory variants, particularly under constrained parameter budgets. Building on this optimized architecture, experimental validation across diverse driving cycles and temperatures (−10 °C to 50 °C) demonstrates that the proposed algorithm significantly outperforms state-of-the-art data-driven baselines in estimation accuracy while requiring substantially fewer trainable parameters. Comprehensive ablation studies further confirm that the TCM and IPLS modules improve the robustness of SOC estimation.

title: Comparative evaluation of advanced SoC estimation and active cell equalization techniques in electric vehicles
abstract: Abstract Advanced State of Charge (SoC) estimation and active cell equalization techniques are essential for improving the accuracy, safety, lifespan, and energy efficiency of lithium-ion batteries in Electric Vehicles (EVs). However, inaccurate SoC estimation, cell imbalance, battery degradation, reduced service life, safety concerns, and inefficient energy utilization remains significant challenges for Battery Management System (BMS). This paper presents a comparative evaluation of advanced SoC estimation and active cell balancing techniques using the Extended Unscented Kalman Filter (EUKF), Multi-Adaptive Square Root Extended Kalman Filter (MA-SREKF), Model Predictive Control (MPC), and Robust Model Predictive Control (RMPC). Under nonlinear operating conditions, the proposed MA-SREKF achieves superior SoC estimation accuracy, reducing the maximum estimation error to ± 1.5% compared with EUKF. For active cell balancing, RMPC outperforms MPC by reducing SoC error fluctuations from ± 8 to ± 3%, resulting in faster convergence and improved balancing accuracy. The comparative results demonstrate that the MA-SREKF and RMPC provide enhanced robustness, reliability, and computational efficiency, making them well suited for real-time BMS applications in EVs.
title_zh: 电动汽车中先进 SOC 估计与主动单体均衡技术的对比评估
one_sentence: 对比 EUKF、MA-SREKF 与 MPC/RMPC 在 SOC 估计与主动单体均衡上的精度与鲁棒性。
problem: SOC 估计精度不足与单体不均衡共同制约 BMS 的寿命、安全与能量效率，需要更鲁棒且计算可行的估计与均衡控制方案。
contributions: 对比扩展无迹卡尔曼滤波（EUKF）与多自适应平方根扩展卡尔曼滤波（MA-SREKF）的 SOC 估计性能，MA-SREKF 最大误差降至 ±1.5%
对比 MPC 与鲁棒 MPC（RMPC）的主动均衡效果，RMPC 将 SOC 误差波动由 ±8% 收敛至 ±3%
给出面向实时 BMS 的鲁棒性与计算效率综合评估结论
bms_relevance: 同时覆盖 SOC 估计与 pack 内单体均衡（cell inconsistency 治理）两大 BMS 核心功能，属于系统级控制与状态估计的直接研究对象。
insight_for_group: 可作为均衡控制与 SOC 估计的对比基线：RMPC 对 SOC 离散度的抑制效果，可与课题组在 pack 不一致性建模中的均衡策略指标对齐；卡尔曼族滤波器的对比结论有助于选择 cloud/edge BMS 中计算开销可接受的估计器。
reason: B 级。主题与 BMS 强相关（SOC 估计 + 主动均衡 + MPC），但发表于 Discover Applied Sciences，不在优先期刊列表内，且方法为已有滤波与控制器的组合对比、缺少 pack 老化与现场数据验证，创新性与证据强度一般。

title: Thermal runaway jet flames of lithium iron phosphate batteries under inclined ceilings: Flame dynamics, ceiling thermal exposure, and safety evaluation
abstract: Battery thermal runaway fires in ceiling-confined spaces can generate jet flames, ceiling impingement, attached flame propagation, and enhanced thermal feedback. The effects of state of charge (SOC) and ceiling inclination angle ( θ ) on the thermal runaway (TR) behavior and jet flame hazards of 32 Ah lithium iron phosphate (LFP) batteries were experimentally investigated. Three SOC levels (0%, 50%, and 100%) and θ (15°, 30°, and 45°) were considered. Battery voltage, surface temperature, expansion force, venting pressure, ceiling temperature, and flame images were recorded. Results show that SOC dominates TR severity and jet combustion intensity. As SOC increases from 0% to 100%, both the peak venting pressure and estimated jet velocity increase significantly. Additionally, higher SOC produces larger flame areas, stronger intermittent eruptive jet fires, and larger flame extension lengths ( L e ). Ceiling inclination mainly regulates post-venting flame attachment and thermal feedback. Lower θ promotes sustained attached flame propagation and stronger ceiling thermal exposure, whereas θ of 45° weakens continuous flame extension. An analytic hierarchy process (AHP)-based comprehensive evaluation method was further developed. The results indicate that increasing SOC accelerates failure development and intensifies TR hazards, whereas θ mainly modifies the relative TR hazards within each SOC group. This study provides experimental evidence and evaluation guidance for fire safety design in energy storage cabinets, battery compartments, and other ceiling-confined battery systems.
title_zh: 倾斜顶棚下磷酸铁锂电池热失控射流火焰：火焰动力学、顶棚热暴露与安全评估
one_sentence: 实验研究不同 SOC 与顶棚倾角下 LFP 电池热失控射流火焰行为及顶棚热暴露风险。
problem: 受限空间（储能柜、电池舱）内热失控射流火焰受 SOC 与顶棚倾角影响，其火焰贴附、热反馈与危害等级缺乏定量评估。
contributions: 在 3 个 SOC（0/50/100%）与 3 个顶棚倾角（15°/30°/45°）下开展 32 Ah LFP 电池热失控实验
揭示 SOC 主导热失控剧烈程度与射流强度，顶棚倾角主要调控泄压后火焰贴附与热反馈
提出基于层次分析法（AHP）的热失控危害综合评价方法，为储能柜防火设计提供依据
bms_relevance: 仅间接相关：研究对象是热失控后的火焰与结构热暴露，属于消防与结构安全设计范畴，不涉及 BMS 的早期预警算法、状态估计或 pack 管理控制。
insight_for_group: 若课题组涉及储能柜安全边界或 TR 传播，可参考其 SOC 对危害等级的定量结论；但作为 BMS 算法研究输入价值有限，建议仅作安全背景备查。
reason: C 级。期刊 Applied Thermal Engineering 不在优先列表中，内容偏燃烧/消防工程与结构热暴露，与 BMS 管理算法无直接关系，列为边缘备选而非推荐。
